shape.name: The price tag (one thing you buy, the company's whole bet)
shape.beats: hook: the thing you buy and its price, the question of how many -> promise: what the company told investors it expects -> the bet made physical -> divided by one price tag, the count growing -> the turn: the pricier edition means fewer copies -> payoff: the count of copies, the most surprising figure -> loop back to the price tag

title: Take-Two's GTA VI forecast: how many $79.99 copies is that? 🎮
description:
GTA VI is out at $79.99. Take-Two expects billions by New Year from all its games: how many copies would that money buy?
Take-Two Interactive is the company behind Grand Theft Auto.
Sources: Take-Two Interactive, reported by iTechPost; Take-Two Interactive Q2 fiscal 2027 results (Business Wire, via Finviz) (Nov 2026). The characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
